review_flags_scope: Actual unordered geometric zero sets from a unique named control root, with active concurrence derived from G1 plus actual nongenericness, and application through actual TimedEventCertificate fields. Partial external prototype only.
reason: The prototype faithfully establishes the bounded central zero-set dichotomy using the actual geometric definitions. A vertex control vanishes exactly when its actual unordered three-label support is a PointZeroTriple; the proof connects the actual area evaluation, chirotope zero, all support permutations and chosen representative support. For an edge control only the valid geometric direction is asserted: actual common membership in all three remote edge interiors forces the actual line-concurrence determinant, and hence that named polynomial, to vanish. No converse from polynomial zero alone is used. A unique vertex-control zero therefore gives exactly one actual point-zero support and no remote interior-concurrence support. In the edge-control branch all vertex controls are nonzero, so the actual point-zero set is empty and G1 holds. Actual nongenericness then forces failure of G2 and supplies a genuine common point in three distinct edge interiors. G1 proves these edges pairwise remote. Thus the actual concurrence set is nonempty; all other edge controls being nonzero force every such support to be the selected one, proving the singleton equality. The transparent ControlCenterSets predicate records precisely those finite-set equalities and hides no premise. The event consumer transports the actual root and other-control nonvanishing through the retained germ-centre equality. Independent examples derive the result from raw source curve assumptions for every event of one actual path, show an existing certificate suffices without an extra nongenericness assumption, and confirm that a Generic tuple has an empty actual concurrence set even conditional on an edge-control zero. All ten declarations and examples independently kernel-check with standard axioms only. Inactive polynomial zeros are not treated as actual wall events. This does not establish the cyclic adjacency cases, named wall types, concurrence-order sign changes, no-cusp result or full original theorem.

mathematical_justification.clause: Actual domains and transparent central predicate
mathematical_justification.assessment: VertexControlName is exactly an unordered three-element finite support of labels; EdgeControlName is exactly an unordered three-element finite support with pairwise remote edges. Each polynomial uses the existing chosen ordered representative whose support equality is proved. PointZeroTriple requires card=3 and chirotope zero for every ordered choice from that support. ConcurrenceTriple requires card=3, pairwise remoteness and ONE actual Plane point in every edge interior. The two zero-set Finsets are powerset filters of these actual predicates. ControlCenterSets matches the name tag and states only the indicated singleton/empty equalities; it contains no root, G1, Generic or truth-assumption field. It is not a synthetic set of polynomial roots.

mathematical_justification.clause: Vertex controls: genuine iff with unordered point zeros
mathematical_justification.assessment: Evaluation of the actual areaPolynomial equals the oriented determinant of the represented three vertices. Real sign equals zero exactly when that determinant is zero. The previously proved pointZeroTriple_iff covers every permutation and repeated choice from the actual three-element support, and the representative support equality transports this statement to v.val. Hence the named vertex control zero iff PointZeroTriple P v.val is a genuine equivalence, independent of the chosen ordering. No vertex injectivity or Regular premise is added to this algebraic/geometric equivalence; those are properties of the actual global path when needed later.

mathematical_justification.clause: Edge controls: actual concurrence implies polynomial zero only
mathematical_justification.assessment: An actual ConcurrenceTriple supplies a common interior point and all support memberships. The representative support equality puts each of the selected three edge labels in that same support. Interior membership implies closed-segment membership, whose actual edge-line equations at the common point force the 3x3 concurrenceDet to vanish. The actual concurrencePolynomial evaluation identity then proves the named control zero. This direction needs no central G1 and remains valid for degenerate tuples. The reverse direction is deliberately absent: a polynomial zero can arise from inactive supporting-line configurations, so it cannot be substituted for an actual interior concurrence.

mathematical_justification.clause: Point singleton and empty-set conclusions are exhaustive
mathematical_justification.assessment: Any member of pointZeroTriples supplies its cardinality-three proof and therefore an actual VertexControlName. The iff above turns membership into that actual named control zero. Nonvanishing of every other vertex control forces equality of the name and hence of its unordered support with the selected one. Conversely the selected control zero gives its support membership. Finset extensionality proves the full singleton equality, not only membership. Similarly, if every vertex control is nonzero the actual point-zero set is empty. If every edge control is nonzero, the one-way geometric concurrence implication excludes every actual member of concurrenceTriples, giving its actual emptiness. These are full finite-set equalities, including all unordered supports.

mathematical_justification.clause: Real active concurrence is derived from nongenericness
mathematical_justification.assessment: With G1 and not Generic, G2 cannot hold, since Generic is exactly G1 and G2. G2 is the negation of existence of three distinct edge labels and an actual common point in all three interiors. Classical double-negation elimination therefore yields such a genuine witness. For each pair, the accepted G1 adjacent-edge intersection theorem and nonzero-edge parameter injectivity rule out a common interior point on adjacent distinct edges; the three pairs are consequently remote. The locally introduced Fact(1<n), used for the Nontrivial instance, is proved from n>=3. The actual concurrenceTriple_iff then creates a member of the real unordered concurrence set. This supplies nonemptiness from actual geometry, not from the selected polynomial zero.

mathematical_justification.clause: Unique active control forces the exact concurrence singleton
mathematical_justification.assessment: Every actual concurrence support defines an EdgeControlName with its real cardinality and remoteness data. The one-way implication makes that control vanish. Nonvanishing of all names other than e forces every actual support to equal e.val, giving a subset of the singleton. The preceding G1/nongeneric argument supplies at least one actual support, proving that e.val itself is present; extensionality yields equality. This helper does not need a separate zero hypothesis for e because the actual active witness already forces it. In the full named-control theorem, the edge branch obtains G1 from the empty point-zero set via the exact pointZeroTriples_empty_iff. No unproved edge-zero-to-concurrence converse appears anywhere.

mathematical_justification.clause: Application through the existing actual event certificate
mathematical_justification.assessment: The certificate root field is at A.path(t), while other_controls is at its returned germ centre. germ_center transports the same selected root to that actual centre. The same equality transports actual nongenericness, so unique_named_control_center_sets applies to the same E.control and E.germ.center. The supplied hng argument of center_sets is redundant for an already constructed certificate: WallGerm already proves its own centre nongeneric, and germ_center transfers this to A.path(t). The independent field-only example verifies that application without any extra nongenericness, root or control hypothesis. No constructor unfolding or replacement event witness is needed.

The raw-source example begins with n>=3, continuity, actual Regular membership, Generic endpoints and delta>0, derives NeZero internally, and constructs one d,W,A. At each actual nongeneric global time it obtains the genuine TimedEventCertificate and the exact ControlCenterSets for that returned event. A second example derives the statement from an arbitrary existing certificate alone. A third conditional example assumes a Generic tuple and a vanishing edge control and proves its actual concurrence set empty directly from G2 and the actual cardinality-three/common-point definition. That test preserves the inactive-root distinction; it is conditional and does not construct or claim an existence witness for an inactive configuration. All ten definitions/theorems and the complete transparent predicate were inspected in the successful independent trace.
